invariants: Version 0.5.0 identifies the portable work-environment protocol and tooling release; it does not change the separately governed Rusty Morphospace platform/runtime baseline.
PowerShell 7.6 LTS or newer Core edition, invoked as pwsh, is the authoritative workflow host; Windows PowerShell 5.1 is supported only as a bootstrap detector that points contributors to pwsh.
An observed repository head is not automatically a claimed, validated, or accepted revision.
Exact multi-repository compositions bind clean tracked commits and trees; uncommitted or untracked source is not silently included.
Detached source materializations are content addressed, clean, exact-tree verified, and never replaced in place.
Machine-local claims coordinate overlapping repo paths, outputs, Android packages, headset serials, property/staging namespaces, and bridge ports without authorizing external mutation.
Parallel APK builds require distinct mutable identities; runs on one headset are serial-scoped transactions.
A run capsule binds the app package/activity, APK, lock, profile, property manifest, build manifest, and exact source revision.
Run cleanup stops only the target package and restores the exact property state observed before the run.
New stable module promotions bind an exact extraction receipt and prove that app defaults, private payloads, platform permissions, and package identity did not cross the reusable boundary.
Existing v1 project and promotion artifacts remain readable and are not rewritten.
